headline: Brazil's XP Posts 4% Net Profit Gain in Q3 as Net Inflows Drop 26%
summary: Brazilian investment platform XP Inc delivered a 4% increase in third-quarter net income to R$1.38 billion ($239 million), even as retail client net inflows contracted by 26%.
why: XP is Brazil's dominant independent retail brokerage platform; declining net inflows indicate cautious consumer savings behavior amid high local interest rates.

impacts.name: XP Inc
impacts.why: A 4% rise in Q3 net profit was offset by a 26% contraction in quarterly net investor inflows.
